section_summary: This section contains correspondence from late May and early June 1941 concerning a proposed visit by the Japanese merchant marine training vessel Kaio Maru to Davao, Philippine Islands, by way of Palau. The Department of State consulted the War and Navy Departments, both of which advised against permitting an 18-day stay for training activities. Based on these views, the Department of State prepared a diplomatic note informing the Japanese Ambassador that the United States Government found it inconvenient to approve the visit.

subfiles.about: Transmittal of the Japanese request for training ship Kaio Maru to visit Davao, soliciting the Navy Department's views.
subfiles.summary: The Secretary of State transmits the Japanese request for the Kaio Maru to visit Davao and solicits Navy views.
subfiles.title: Note from the Secretary of State to the Secretary of the Navy regarding Proposed Visit of the Kaio Maru to Davao

subfiles.about: Diplomatic note informing the Japanese Ambassador that the United States Government cannot approve the Kaio Maru's visit to Davao.
subfiles.summary: The Secretary of State informs the Japanese Ambassador that the United States cannot approve the Kaio Maru's visit to Davao.
subfiles.title: Note from the Secretary of State to the Japanese Ambassador Disapproving Visit of the Kaio Maru to Davao

subfiles.about: War Department communication advising that it is inconvenient to approve the training vessel Kaio Maru's visit to Davao.
subfiles.summary: The Secretary of War advises that the War Department finds it inconvenient to approve the Kaio Maru's visit to Davao.
subfiles.title: Note from the Secretary of War to the Secretary of State regarding Proposed Visit of the Kaio Maru to Davao

subfiles.about: Telephone transcription of a Navy letter recommending that the Kaio Maru's 18-day visit to Davao be declared inconvenient.
subfiles.summary: Commander McCracken dictates Forrestal's letter recommending rejection of the Kaio Maru's 18-day visit to Davao as inconvenient.
subfiles.title: Telephone Dictation of Navy Department Letter regarding Proposed Visit of the Kaio Maru to Davao

subfiles.about: Official Navy Department letter recommending that the United States inform Japan that the Kaio Maru's visit is inconvenient.
subfiles.summary: Forrestal recommends informing Japan that the Kaio Maru's proposed 18-day training visit to Davao is inconvenient.
subfiles.title: Letter from the Assistant Secretary of the Navy to the Secretary of State regarding Proposed Visit of the Kaio Maru to Davao
